summary: Modoc NF lookout built 1936 on a Plan BC-301 cabin; register lists removal date as unknown, firelookout.org says gone; no source describes the site today.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin on an enclosed timber tower (register: 10-foot tower; 1948 survey sheet: 15-foot tower)
facts.status_note: Register lists removal date as unknown; firelookout.org lists the site as gone; no removal date found in sources read
facts.agency: US Forest Service - Modoc National Forest

events.note: Constructed in 1936 as a Plan BC-301 cabin on an enclosed timber tower (register)

Henry K. Keene named fire guard at the lookout (Weekly Adin Argus item, Aug 3, 1939)
November 1944 work-project budget: lookout observation unit with living quarters underneath; garage, storage, water storage, windcharger, latrine; cistern in place

June 13, 1947 inspection report: generally in good condition; shutter bolts did not work satisfactorily
Ben Bath of Adin to be stationed at the lookout (Weekly Adin Argus item, June 19, 1947)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register describes a 10-foot enclosed timber tower; a 1948 Coast and Geodetic Survey sheet describes a 15-foot tower. The brief's 4.6 m matches 15 feet, so height_m uses the survey figure; the story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Height conflict between register (10 ft) and 1948 survey sheet (15 ft); height_m follows the survey figure. Removal date unknown in every source read, so no removal event. No current description or access level found, so no access block. The register page's 2008 photo was not viewed; its caption gives no detail. The brief lists two coordinate sets; this research did not check the second one. Used one web search and about five page reads.
